name: xTool F1 Ultra
notes: Galvo laser with a 1064 nm fiber laser and a 455 nm blue diode. See also xtool-f1-ultra-gs003 (the newer extension, device code GS003).
source: xTool Studio 1.9.11 device extension GS002 (exts/F1Ultra), read 2026-11-26. Work area from processingArea (LASER_PLANE 220 x 220); modules from defaultPower [20, 20] (redPower, laserPower), the label 455-20W / 1064-20W and the fiber_ir_blue text key. Which operations each module can do is an assumption.
